game.title: Hogwarts Legacy
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set at Hogwarts in the 1800s, from Avalanche Software, released 2023-02-10. RAWG average playtime: 30 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Your fifth-year journey through Hogwarts and the mystery of ancient magic.

chapters.title: Classes, Spells and Talents
chapters.summary: Learn every spell, spend Talent Points and level up.

chapters.title: Duelling and Combat
chapters.summary: Combos, Petrificus Totalus, Mandrakes and Ancient Magic in battle.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Challenges
chapters.summary: Side quests, challenge tiers and battle arenas.

chapters.title: Exploring the Castle and Highlands
chapters.summary: Floo Flames, Merlin Trials, Demiguise statues, cairn dungeons and collections.

chapters.title: Room of Requirement
chapters.summary: Gear upgrades, potions, plants and beast breeding.

notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls subpages are linked but not written. hogwartslegacy.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page links to only 2 pages. The Steam schema calls the app "PHX" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 990080. 21 of 45 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder.
